==Events==

*{{ne|978}} - A man named [[Ries Gorthanes]], posing as a [[Tower Guard]], arrives at a [[Tar Valon]] bank and passes a forged letter from the [[Amyrlin Seat]] requesting the financial records of [[Moiraine Damodred]]. Although Gorthanes is apprehended, he escapes before the Tower Guards arrive.
